Independent exact rational tournament enumeration and symbolic variance
correctness.rationale: Writing X_ab as the rank-forward edge indicator and Y_ab=X_ab-p, direct expansion of the two cyclic orientations on a<b<c cancels the cubic term and yields (I_abc-r)=(1-2p)Y_ac+Y_abY_bc-Y_abY_ac-Y_bcY_ac. The linear and quadratic sums are orthogonal, as are distinct centered unordered incident-edge products, so E C_n=binom(n,3)r and Var C_n=3binom(n,3)r²+[n(n-1)²(n-2)/12]r(1-2p)². I independently enumerated every tournament orientation for n=3,4,5 at several rational p and matched moments. Inside sqrt(n)(p_n-1/2)->c, each linear coefficient O(sqrt n), each quadratic coefficient ±1. Any surviving k-th joint cumulant monomial diagram must have each centered edge repeated and connected; for s linear terms, at most k-s/2 distinct edges and k-s/2+1 labeled vertices. This gives O_k(n^{k+1}) k-th cumulants, which after division by n^{3k/2} vanish for k≥3. The variance coefficient tends to c²/12+1/32; Gaussian moment determinacy gives weak convergence. Outside the window with p away from {0,1}, Q has negligible L² variance and independent bounded weighted Y terms satisfy Lindeberg, giving the stated normalized CLT. The finite enumeration does not certify either limit theorem.
residual_risks: No CLT claimed when p_n approaches 0 or1 outside the window, no local limit or Berry–Esseen rate.

checked_sources: Natural motif count in independent-edge noisy order
Exact orthogonal variance and critical Gaussian scaling
value.rationale: The natural triangle count of a noisy total order exhibits a sharp change in stochastic fluctuation scale controlled by one bias parameter. The explicit critical-window variance, including the fair degenerate component and rank-induced linear component, gives a meaningful local phase diagram useful in random ranking and tournament models.
residual_risks: Weak CLT only, no sparse or near-deterministic edge regime.

final_claim: For independent rank-biased tournament edge orientations, directed triangle counts have an exact linear–quadratic decomposition and variance and converge to a Gaussian in the sqrt(n)(p_n-1/2)->c window with variance 1/32+c²/12; bounded-away-from-degenerate biases outside the window have the matching linear CLT.
limitations: The fair endpoint is not independently novel.
No higher-order joint or local limit theorem, and no uniform rate.
